yt:82uqNAacOco.why: The audio list subject reads "Dravyadrushti Prakash 405", but the video is titled Drashti ke Nidhan 405 and the sitting is filed under that text. The number is the part both catalogues agree on; the text name in the subject is the scribes shorthand for a different book.

yt:hXEP03uS3HA.why: The sitting is Darshan Parishah — दर्शन परीषह, the affliction concerning faith, one of the twenty-two — confirmed by Tejas, and the video is titled that way. The catalogue files it under "Other discourses" with the reference run together and misspelt as "Darshanparishad", a parishad being an assembly, which is a different word. Naming it also lets the transcript reach it: a day with two sittings is told apart by the text name, and "Other discourses" shares no word with the recording, so the transcript had nowhere to go.
